steps.content: The two illusions of Hecate vanish together, returning underground.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Who are you? How do you know...
...I only heard the voice of your heart.
Go... Your emotions are no longer trapping you...

The illusory realm is beginning to fall apart, the invisible wall separating Hecate and ${PlayerName} disappearing. What's motivating her to act, whether this is the right thing to do, perhaps one day she'll find the answers to these questions, but not now.
Right now, she just wants to be back to ${PlayerName}'s side as soon as possible.
